subject: Scheduling dedicated/private demo with regional security reviewers (EU DPO, APAC security)
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintech-example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers needed

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We are very interested in a walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated/Private for our compliance team. Our security director would like the EU DPO (Anna Müller) and our APAC partner (Kenji Sato at Tanaka Co.) to attend. They’re available the first week of November but times across zones are tricky — Anna is CET, Kenji is JST, and we’re mostly ET.

Can you propose 2–3 slots that would work for Redwood and indicate timezone conversions (we had some DST confusion last quarter)? 30–45 minute demo; DPO will want to see the audit log and data residency slides.

Thanks!
— Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Integrations, FinTech Partners Ltd.
(sarah@fintech-example.com)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintech-example.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers needed

Hi Sarah —

Great — thanks for the context. I’ve looped in Dylan (solutions engineering) and Neha (security/compliance PM) so we have the right folks for DPO questions and deployment details.

A couple of housekeeping notes before proposing slots:
- US daylight saving time ends on Nov 1 this year, so US times will be standard time (e.g., ET = UTC-5). EU (CET) and Japan (JST) are on their standard offsets as usual; please double-check local calendars.
- We’ll plan for a 45-minute call: 25-min demo + 15-min DPO/security Q&A + 5-min next steps.

Option A (works for our SE team):
- Tue, Nov 3 — 11:00 UTC (07:00 ET / 12:00 CET / 20:00 JST)
Option B (later for APAC, slightly early for US):
- Wed, Nov 4 — 09:00 UTC (05:00 ET / 10:00 CET / 18:00 JST)
Option C (good overlap for EU mid-afternoon):
- Wed, Nov 3 — 14:00 UTC (10:00 ET / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST)

Please let us know which of the above three options is preferable. If none work, tell us a couple of times Anna and Kenji prefer in their local time and we’ll convert.

I’ve attached a short agenda and will share a calendar invite once we confirm. Also cc’ing Neha so she can prepare the DPO checklist items.

Agenda (attached): agenda-dedicated-private-demo.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://calendly.com/marissa_cole/ri-dedicated-demo

From: Anna Müller <anna.muller@acme-eu.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah@fintech-example.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 17:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers needed

Hi Marissa / Sarah —

Thanks for including me. I can make short windows on Nov 3 or Nov 4, preferably mid-morning CET.

I prefer: Nov 4 at 10:00 CET (that’s 09:00 UTC). If that is option B (as you listed) — perfect. If you schedule earlier on Nov 3, I may need a quick heads-up — travel that day.

I’ve attached our DPO checklist; I may forward a couple of pre-reads. Please ensure the demo covers:
- Data residency controls and region pinning
- Audit logs and retention settings
- Access controls / role-based access for Dedicated clusters

Thanks,
Anna
DPO, Acme EU
Attachment: DPO-Checklist.xlsx

From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tanaka.co.jp>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah@fintech-example.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 00:45:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Dedicated/private deployment demo — security reviewers needed

Hello all —

Thank you for looping me in. Japan does not observe DST so our local time is always JST (UTC+9). I’m generally available after 18:00 JST on weekdays. From the options below, Option B (Nov 4 — 09:00 UTC = 18:00 JST) works best for me. Option A (11:00 UTC = 20:00 JST) would also work but Option C (23:00 JST) is quite late.

If you confirm Nov 4 09:00 UTC, please send the invite with times shown in UTC and JST.

Regards,
Kenji Sato
Head of Security Partnerships, Tanaka Co.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintech-example.com>, Anna Müller <anna.muller@acme-eu.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@tanaka.co.jp>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Confirmed: Dedicated/private demo — Nov 4 09:00 UTC (09:00 UTC / 05:00 ET / 10:00 CET / 18:00 JST)

Thanks everyone — great to get alignment. Confirming Option B:
- Date: Wed, Nov 4, 2026
- Time: 09:00 UTC (05:00 ET / 10:00 CET / 18:00 JST)
- Duration: 45 minutes
- Agenda: quick intro (5) / demo of Dedicated + private control plane (25) / DPO Q&A (15) / next steps (5)

Notes:
- Reminder: US DST ended on Nov 1; if anyone’s calendar still shows old offsets please double-check.
- Dylan will send the calendar invite with a Zoom link and include the attached agenda and the DPO checklist.

Action items:
- Dylan: send calendar invite + Zoom + slide deck link
- Neha: prepare the audit log screenshots and region pinning demo
- Anna: if you have any pre-reads, please send them before EOD tomorrow

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
